args: Start-Process cmd.exe -ArgumentList '/c start wt.exe --window -1 -d "${workspaceFolder}" -- pwsh.exe -NoExit -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${workspaceFolder}\.vscode\scripts\launch-agy-wsl.ps1"'

nohup wt.exe --window -1 wsl.exe -d tupynambalucasdev-ubuntu --cd ~/projects/tupynambalucas bash --login -c 'if command -v agy >/dev/null 2>&1; then agy; elif [ -f package.json ]; then pnpm agy; else echo "Antigravity CLI not installed yet. Run: pnpm add -g @google/antigravity-cli"; exec bash; fi; exec bash' >/dev/null 2>&1 &

Start-Process cmd.exe -ArgumentList '/c start wt.exe --window -1 --profile "Antigravity" -d "${workspaceFolder}" -- pwsh.exe -NoExit -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${workspaceFolder}\.vscode\scripts\launch-agy.ps1"'
if command -v agy >/dev/null 2>&1; then agy; else pnpm agy; fi

Start-Process cmd.exe -Verb RunAs -ArgumentList '/c start wt.exe --window -1 --profile "Admin" -d "${workspaceFolder}" -- pwsh.exe -NoExit -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${workspaceFolder}\.vscode\scripts\launch-mage.ps1"'
clear; echo 'Admin shell ready.'; exec bash
